title: [YouPass Collect] - Energy production in France and Germany
prompt: The pie charts below show the comparison of different kinds of energy production of France and Germany in 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The pie charts give information about energy production from various sources in France and Germany in the year 2020.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, it can be seen that nearly all energy generated in the two countries came from only five sources, with gas, nuclear and solar power being the most important ones.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the largest power sources, in France, gas took the lead, constituting 30% of their energy production, 5% higher than the corresponding figure for Germany. The most utilized type of energy in Germany was solar power, at 28%, while it accounted for a quarter of the total in France. Additionally, France also generated 25% of its energy from nuclear power, which was higher than Germany's 18%.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the remaining power sources, 14% and 10% of energy in Germany was produced by burning petrol and coal respectively, which were 4% and 3% higher than in France. Finally, the proportions of other, unlisted energy types were negligible in both countries, collectively ranging from 3% to 5%.
